full_prompt_en: A square textile artwork shows a dense embroidered cluster of small flowers and leaves spreading diagonally across coarse ivory fabric. The woven ground is clearly visible in the upper-left and around the outer edges, its raised horizontal and vertical threads forming a regular grain. From the lower left, slender stitched stems climb toward the upper right and branch into many flowers. Petals in deep red, burnt orange, mustard yellow and muted cream overlap so tightly that some blossoms partly hide others. Near the middle, several warm yellow flowers open into broad five-petaled forms with darker stitched centers. Smaller red blossoms sit along the left edge and toward the lower middle, supplying compact accents among the larger shapes. Olive gray-green and dark indigo leaves cut between the petals, their pointed forms and stitch direction distinguishing them from the rounded blooms. At the upper right, the bouquet becomes more tangled and richly colored, with orange and blue folds pressing against the picture edge. Threads are laid in different directions to follow each leaf and petal, making the surface catch light in small uneven glints. The lighting is soft and even from above, emphasizing relief in the yarn and tiny shadows between raised stitches rather than creating a strong external cast shadow. No vase or horizon is shown; the pattern sits directly on the fabric field. The overall composition turns a concentrated diagonal burst of warm color into a tactile, handcrafted contrast with the open pale weave.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形纺织艺术在粗纹象牙色布料上绣出一簇浓密的小花与叶片，沿对角线铺展。左上和外缘清楚露出织物底，凸起的横纵纱线组成有规律的纹理。从左下开始，细绣茎向右上攀升并分叉成许多花朵。深红、焦橙、芥黄和压低的奶油色花瓣紧密重叠，一些花朵部分遮住另一些。中央附近，几朵暖黄色花展开成宽阔五瓣形，中心有较深的绣线。较小红花落在左缘和下方中部，在大花之间形成紧凑强调。橄榄灰绿和深靛蓝叶片插入花瓣之间，其尖形轮廓与绣线方向都不同于圆润花朵。右上角花束更纠缠、色彩更浓，橙色和蓝色褶叠挤向画边。绣线沿着各片叶与花瓣的形态向不同方向铺排，使表面在细小不匀的亮点上接光。光从上方柔和均匀照来，强调纱线浮雕感和凸起针脚间的微小阴影，而非强烈外部投影。画中没有花瓶或地平线，纹样直接落在布底上。整体构图让集中的斜向暖色迸发与敞开的浅色织纹形成可触的手工对照。
style_prompt_en: The textile image is built from raised directional stitches over a visibly coarse woven ground. Warm rust, ochre, cream and wine-red areas gather densely, while muted olive and deep indigo strokes cool and separate them. Petal-like rounded marks and pointed linear marks overlap in an irregular diagonal movement, leaving a portion of pale ground open. Edges are crisp in thread relief yet slightly uneven at the individual stitch level. Gentle overhead light catches the high fibers and leaves tiny recess shadows, making color and texture inseparable. The result is ornate but grounded by the visible fabric grid and the breathing space around its most concentrated area.
style_prompt_zh: 这种纺织图像由可见粗织底上的凸起定向针脚构成。暖锈色、赭黄、奶油色与葡萄酒红密集聚拢，压低的橄榄色与深靛蓝笔状区域则为其降温并分隔。圆润的瓣状笔痕和尖细线性痕迹以不规则对角动势重叠，留下部分浅色底敞开。边缘因线迹浮雕而清楚，单个针脚层面却略有不齐。温和顶光照住较高纤维，并在凹处留下微小阴影，使色彩与肌理难以分开。成品装饰丰厚，但可见布格和密集区周围的呼吸空间稳住了画面。
theme_en: A dense embroidered bouquet of warm flowers on coarse ivory fabric
theme_zh: 粗纹象牙色织物上的一束密集暖色刺绣花卉
name: Sue Reno
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
